item.title: The Interim Computer Museum
item.description:
📝 × Welcome to the Interim Computer Museum Online. The Interim Computer Museum (ICM) strives to preserve and share the history of computing through interactive exhibits using vintage hardware with modern enhancements. Membership is crucial to our mission which supports the museum's activities through community events, remote access and artifact preservation.
🔗 Read more: https://icm.museum/

item.title: AgentsDock: An IDE designed for agentic AI research
item.description:
📝 Your lab workstation, your Mac mini at home, a rented GPU box — connect them all and switch between them anytime, from every device you own. Attach to your chat's persistent tmux session from any device — the same shell, everywhere. Install the desktop client, connect it to your AgentsDock server, and keep Claude and Codex available from every machine you use.
🔗 Read more: https://agentsdock.net/
